payload.text: **Known and shipping as-is unless ruled otherwise** (2026-09-11): a_daemon_outlives_nobody.rs flakes roughly 1 in 20 in parallel, mechanism unconfirmed, and the cut's gate carries it with issue 0481's one re-run of intentd's load-sensitive family. Its WAL half is fixed: hv ruled it otherwise on 2026-11-17 (hv decision 59), and issue 0701 (landed at 108bd41aa) has the store set journal_size_limit, so SQLite cuts the WAL file back to 16 MiB instead of keeping its high-water mark (559 MB truncated by hand on 2026-09-10; 296 MB on 2026-11-17).
